title: Einstein-Lovelock field equations for a4[x4] and b4[x4] in the primordial metric with b4 (Revision/SPEC.md section 5), for GENERAL functions a4 and b4 > 0 (since 2026-10-15; b4 is never set to 1); the key b4 holds the formulas of 2026-10-14 in the raw variables b4, b4', b4'' for the readers that use them

conventions.coordinates: the author's coordinates x0..x7: x0 = hidden direction, z = 6 H x0 in (0, pi/2); x1, x2, x3 = 3-space (scale factor e^{a4} sin^{1/6} z); x4 = time; x5, x6, x7 = extra times, time-like, deflating (scale factor e^{-a4} b4^{1/2} sin^{1/6} z)
conventions.symbols: ad1 = a4'(x4), ad2 = a4''(x4), uu = b4'/b4, vv = (b4'/b4)' (b4''/b4 = vv + uu^2), H > 0, alpha1..alpha3 = Lovelock couplings, Lam = Lambda, kappa = gravitational coupling, cc = cot z; AA, be = the parameters of an exponential history; d4f, d0f = partial derivatives of f with respect to x4, x0
conventions.curvature: MTW: R^a_{bcd} = d_c Gamma^a_{bd} - d_d Gamma^a_{bc} + Gamma^a_{ce} Gamma^e_{bd} - Gamma^a_{de} Gamma^e_{bc}
conventions.fieldEquations: sum_{k=1}^{3} alpha_k E_(k)^mu_nu + Lam delta^mu_nu = kappa T^mu_nu
conventions.source: T^mu_nu = diag(p0, p3, p3, p3, -rho, p_t, p_t, p_t) (order x0..x7) + q40 (mu = x4, nu = x0) + q04 (mu = x0, nu = x4); rho = -T^x4_x4, p_mu = T^mu_mu (no sum)

x4x0.tex: -\frac{3}{2} \left(24 (a_4')^2 \cot z H u-12 (a_4') \cot z H u^2+40 \cot z H^3 u-\cot z H u^3\right)

x0x4.tex: \frac{3 \left(24 (a_4')^2 H u-12 (a_4') H u^2+40 H^3 u-H u^3\right)}{2 \cot z}

lovelockTensors.allOtherComponents: x2x2 = x3x3 = x1x1, x6x6 = x7x7 = x5x5; the only nonzero off-diagonal components are x4x0 and x0x4 (proportional to b4'); every component depends on b4 only through uu = b4'/b4 and vv = (b4'/b4)' (exact, all 64 components checked)

generalSource.offDiagonal_other: 0 = kappa T^mu_nu for every other mu != nu (the left-hand sides vanish identically)
generalSource.secondOrderSystem: the x1 - x5 and x0 components are linear in (ad2, vv) with Jacobian J; det J below; where det J != 0 they determine a4'' and (b4'/b4)' from the sources, and the x4 component is the constraint
generalSource.x0_dependence: the diagonal left-hand sides are free of x0 (and of a4 itself), so the diagonal source must satisfy d0 rho = d0 p3 = d0 p_t = d0 p0 = 0; the off-diagonal pair must be kappa q40 = cot z uu Q, kappa q04 = -tan z uu Q: unless uu Q = 0 the source has an x0-dependent off-diagonal pair

conservation_x4.tex: -3 (a_4') p_3+3 (a_4') p_t-\frac{3 b_4' p_t}{2 b_4}-\frac{3 b_4' \rho }{2 b_4}-\frac{6 H q_{04}}{\cot z}+\partial_0 q_{04}-\partial_4 \rho = 0

conservation_x0.tex: \frac{3 b_4' q_{40}}{2 b_4}+6 \cot z H p_0-3 \cot z H p_3-3 \cot z H p_t+\partial_0 p_0+\partial_4 q_{40} = 0

generalSource.constraint_propagation: d/dx4 [sum_k alpha_k E^x4_x4] = 3 ad1 (E^x1_x1 - E^x5_x5) + (3/2) uu (E^x5_x5 - E^x4_x4) + 6 H uu Q identically (the x4 component of the Bianchi identity)

authorWeights.branch: at AA = 1: Q = 3 be (3 be - 4)/(64 H), so q40 = 0 exactly for be = 0 (b4 constant, excluded) and be = 4/3
authorWeights.historySource: AA = 1, be = 4/3: kappa (rho, p3, p_t, p0) = (-2/27, -2/9, -22/27, -14/27), q40 = q04 = 0 (not a vacuum; a prescribed background, SPEC section 1)
authorWeights.vacuum: an exponential history is a vacuum solution exactly for be = 0 (b4 constant) and AA = +-1; none with b4 not constant

exponentialHistory.einsteinGaussBonnetVacuum: alpha1 = 1, alpha3 = 0: vacuum exponential histories with b4 not constant exactly for be = 4, alpha2 = 1/(40 H^2 (1 - AA^2)) and for be = 2 (1 + AA^2)/AA^2, alpha2 = -AA^2/(4 H^2 (AA^2 - 1)^2) < 0 (AA^2 != 1), Lambda = -E^x4_x4

lemmas.gravityTerm: gamma^mu Omega_mu = 3 H gamma^x0 + (3/4)(b4'/b4) gamma^x4 (canonical spin connection; Omega_x4 = Omega_x0 = 0)
lemmas.diagonalKinetic: {gamma^mu, Omega_mu} = 0 for each mu (no sum), so K^mu_mu = (1/2)(Psibar gamma^mu d_mu Psi - d_mu Psibar gamma^mu Psi) contains no spin connection; for a configuration independent of x_mu, K^mu_mu = 0
lemmas.traceOnShell: sum_mu K^mu_mu = (m + U'(S)) S on shell (both statistics), so the on-shell Lagrangian is L = S U'(S) - U(S)

fields.emtConvention: T^mu_nu = sigmaT ( -K^(mu_nu) + delta^mu_nu L ), K^mu_nu = (1/2)(Psibar gamma^mu D_nu Psi - D_nu Psibar gamma^mu Psi), symmetrised; sigmaT = +1 is the convention of SPEC section 4 (homogeneous on-shell states: rho = m S + U, p = S U' - U)

generalFormulas.kmu: k_mu = K^mu_mu (no sum) = (1/2)(Psibar gamma^mu d_mu Psi - d_mu Psibar gamma^mu Psi); L = k0+k1+k2+k3+k4+k5+k6+k7 - m S - U(S) (on shell S U'(S) - U(S))
generalFormulas.offDiagonal: T^mu_nu = -sigmaT K^(mu_nu) for mu != nu, not x4-x0, must vanish (0 = kappa T^mu_nu); the x4-x0 pair must equal cot z uu Q/kappa and -tan z uu Q/kappa

dirac16complex00.statement: classical commuting Phi; k_mu, S, U are classical bilinears
dirac16complex00.homogeneousCondensate: Phi = Phi(x4) on shell, independent of x0..x3, x5..x7 (d4 Phi = A Phi, A = A0 - (3/4)(b4'/b4) I16, A0 = -gamma^x4 (M - 3 H gamma^x0), M = m + U'(S)): Phi = b4^(-3/4) chi with d4 chi = A0 chi; b4^(3/2) S is constant (exact), S = b4^(-3/2) S0; the diagonal kinetic components are K^x4_x4 = M S and 0 for every other direction, and K^x4_x0 = 0; hence rho = sigmaT (m S + U(S)), p3 = p_t = p0 = sigmaT (S U'(S) - U(S)), q40 = q04 = 0
dirac16complex00.offDiagonalConditions: the off-diagonal field equations 0 = kappa T^mu_nu (mu != nu, not x4-x0) require the 15 bilinears B_abc = Phibar gamma^a gamma^b gamma^c Phi (frame gammas) to vanish
dirac16complex00.offDiagonalWitness: exact solutions with all 15 bilinears zero and S != 0 exist for every b4: Phi = b4^(-3/4) e^{-i w x4} Phi0, w = sqrt(M^2 - 9 H^2) (M^2 > 9 H^2), Phi0 = v1 + c v2 from the two A0-eigenvectors with gamma^x1 gamma^x5 = gamma^x2 gamma^x6 = gamma^x3 gamma^x7 = -1 and +1, c = conj(v1^dagger C v2); checked exactly at (M, H) = (5, 1), (5, 4/3), (-5, 1) (wolfram report, condensate_diagonal_witness_exact)
dirac16complex00.asSource: the condensate source has q40 = q04 = 0 and p3 = p_t = p0: with b4 not constant it is impossible in Einstein gravity (b4' = 0 is forced), it sources no exponential history with be != 0 for the author's weights, and in Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet only the two tuned branches of exponentialHistory.einsteinGaussBonnetVacuum; histories that are not exponential are not decided (wolfram report, condensate_source_with_b4_not_constant)

dirac16complex.statement: quantised Psi (SPEC section 6): every bilinear is replaced by the expectation value of the normal-ordered operator in the state, <:k_mu:>, <:S:>, <:U(S):> (note <U(S)> != U(<S>) in general); the trace identity sum_mu <:k_mu:> = <:(m + U'(S)) S:> for the normal-ordered operators of the field on a whole slice is ASSUMED here, not proved. It is decided only in a finite model, by Revision/theory/fock_quartic (reports/fock-quartic.json: one good-sector plane-wave mode set with frozen coefficients, flat frame, volume 1, 16 modes, 2^16 states, U = (lambda/2) S^2 with symbolic lambda). Nothing is proved for the field on a whole slice (many momenta), for the curved x0 dependence with its boundary term at z = pi/2, or for the extra-time sector
dirac16complex.offDiagonal: every off-diagonal expectation value <:T^mu_nu:> (mu != nu, not x4-x0) must vanish, and the x4-x0 pair must equal cot z uu Q/kappa, -tan z uu Q/kappa
dirac16complex.kohnSham: Kohn-Sham source (Revision/kohn_sham): rho_KS(x4), p3_KS(x4), p_t_KS(x4), p0_KS(x4) from the occupied Kohn-Sham orbitals; with this source the equations of generalSource apply with these entries; the source conditions (every diagonal entry independent of x0, the x4-x0 pair as above) are evaluated in Revision/field_equations_a4/reports/ks-source-conditions.json

b4.metric: the user's metric of 2026-10-14 (SPEC section 1): g55 = g66 = g77 = -E^(-2 a4[x4]) b4[x4] Sin[6 H x0]^(1/3), b4 > 0; symbols bb = b4, bd1 = b4', bd2 = b4'', uu = b4'/b4

lovelockTensors.allOtherComponents: x2x2 = x3x3 = x1x1, x6x6 = x7x7 = x5x5; the only nonzero off-diagonal components are x4x0 and x0x4 (proportional to b4'); equal to Revision/metric_b4/results/metric-b4.json

offDiagonal_x4x0.tex: \frac{3 \left(360 (a_4')^4 \alpha_3 b_4^2 b_4' \cot z H-360 (a_4')^3 \alpha_3 b_4 b_4'^2 \cot z H-24 (a_4')^2 \alpha_2 b_4^2 b_4' \cot z H+432 (a_4')^2 \alpha_3 b_4^2 b_4' \cot z H^3+90 (a_4')^2 \alpha_3 b_4'^3 \cot z H+12 (a_4') \alpha_2 b_4 b_4'^2 \cot z H-216 (a_4') \alpha_3 b_4 b_4'^2 \cot z H^3+\alpha_1 b_4^2 b_4' \cot z H-40 \alpha_2 b_4^2 b_4' \cot z H^3+\alpha_2 b_4'^3 \cot z H+360 \alpha_3 b_4^2 b_4' \cot z H^5-18 \alpha_3 b_4'^3 \cot z H^3\right)}{2 b_4^3} = \kappa  q_{40}

generalSource.offDiagonalStatement: kappa q40 = cot z (b4'/b4) Q and kappa q04 = -tan z (b4'/b4) Q: a source with q40 = q04 = 0 (in particular every source that is x0-independent and has no T^x4_x0) forces b4' Q = 0; for Einstein gravity Q = 3 H/2, so b4' = 0
generalSource.identity_einstein: kappa (p3 + p_t - 2 p0) = (b4'/b4)^2/4 + b4''/(2 b4) (Einstein); with b4' = b4'' = 0 the earlier condition p3 + p_t = 2 p0

conservation_x4.tex: -3 (a_4') p_3+3 (a_4') p_t-\frac{3 b_4' p_t}{2 b_4}-\frac{3 b_4' \rho }{2 b_4}-\frac{6 H q_{04}}{\cot z}+\partial_0 q_{04}-\partial_4 \rho = 0

conservation_x0.tex: \frac{3 b_4' q_{40}}{2 b_4}+6 \cot z H p_0-3 \cot z H p_3-3 \cot z H p_t+\partial_0 p_0+\partial_4 q_{40} = 0

generalSource.secondOrderEinstein: the x1 - x5 and x0 components are linear in (a4'', b4'') with a nonsingular Jacobian: they determine a4'' and b4'' from the sources; the x4 component is the constraint

fields.condensate: d4 Phi = (A - (3/4)(b4'/b4) I16) Phi: Phi = b4^(-3/4) Phi_1 (Phi_1 a b4 = 1 solution); b4^(3/2) S is constant; K^x4_x4 = M S, K^mu_mu = 0 (mu != x4), K^x4_x0 = 0; the same 15 off-diagonal three-gamma bilinears with b4-dependent coefficients

b4.background: with the author's weights (w1 = 1, w2 = 1/32, w3 = 1/1152, Lambda = 10) every vacuum solution has b4 constant and a4 = +-H x4 + const (Revision/metric_b4/results/vacuum-b4.json); the record uses the prescribed history a4 = H x4, b4 = b4(0) e^((4/3) H x4) (key exponentialHistory.authorWeights; SPEC section 1)
